wiki_acceptance: Drag a box over 3 pawns -> all 3 show selection ring; a right-click move-order moves all 3.

design.self_bootstrap: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] -> hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO '~MarqueeSelector' + FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard (MineDesignation pattern).
design.gesture_split: Owns left-DRAG only: arm on mouse-down over EMPTY ground (no PawnEntity under cursor), promote to drag once cursor moves >= dragThresholdPixels (6px default), finalize on mouse-up. A below-threshold press/release does NOTHING here so ClickSelector's single left-CLICK still single-selects -> no double-fire (click vs drag is mutually exclusive by the threshold).
design.ring_visual: Each boxed pawn gets PawnEntity.SetSelected(true) -> reuses the existing selection tint/marker the single-select path uses. ClearMultiSelection drops the rings.
design.box_query: Physics2D.OverlapAreaNonAlloc(min,max,buf[256]) then GetComponent<PawnEntity>() filter (mirrors ClickSelector's OverlapPoint+GetComponent approach); skips IsDead + de-dups multi-collider pawns. No per-frame List alloc.
design.move_order: Right-click while HasMultiSelection: for each pawn clear residual chopper/gatherer/hunter/cook tasks (exactly as ClickSelector's empty-ground branch) then PawnMovement.SetTarget + ManualMoveUntil = Time.time + 15f. REUSES existing move API; NO new pathfinding.
design.guards: InputBlocked() skips when EventSystem.IsPointerOverGameObject, BuildManager.BuildModeActive, DeconstructDesignation.ModeActive, MineDesignation.ModeActive, GrowZoneDesignation.ModeActive, or ContextMenuUI.IsOpen.
design.overlay: GL quad (translucent fill) + GL.LINES border drawn in OnRenderObject using Hidden/Internal-Colored, viewport-space (LoadOrtho + WorldToViewportPoint). No extra GameObject; Camera.current==cam guard avoids double-draw; lineMat destroyed in OnDestroy.

bug_firewall.4_audio_buzz: no AudioBank loop (no audio calls at all).
bug_firewall.7_singleton_subscription_race: managers POLLED in Update (singleton-subscriber), no .OnX subscription in OnEnable.
bug_firewall.9_runinbackground_freeze: no coroutine / no WaitForSeconds / no background timer; overlay is frame-driven via OnRenderObject.

flags_for_qa: MARQUEE OVERLAY RENDER: marquee rectangle uses GL in OnRenderObject with Hidden/Internal-Colored shader + LoadOrtho viewport-space. QA confirm the box renders during drag (translucent green fill + border) in batchmode/build and is not invisible or mis-projected.
MULTI-SELECT RING VISUALS: each boxed pawn calls PawnEntity.SetSelected(true). QA confirm a 3-pawn box -> all 3 show the selection tint/ring simultaneously (B1 acceptance).

NO DOUBLE-FIRE WITH ClickSelector LEFT-CLICK: a single click (<6px move) must still single-select via ClickSelector and must NOT start a marquee; a drag (>=6px) must multi-select and ClickSelector's single ring is dropped via SetSelected(false). QA confirm clicking a pawn single-selects (ClickSelector) while drag-on-empty multi-selects (this file), with no two-ring competing state.

RIGHT-CLICK MOVE-ALL: with a marquee active, one right-click moves ALL selected pawns (PawnMovement.SetTarget reused). QA confirm all 3 walk to the clicked point (B1 acceptance). Note: marquee right-click uses the UNDRAFTED manual-move branch for every pawn (drafted-specific attack semantics stay under ClickSelector single-select).

ClickSelector.cs was NOT edited (lane firewall held). ClearClickSelectorSingle() only calls PawnEntity.SetSelected(false) on ClickSelector.CurrentSelection (read-only public getter) to avoid two competing rings.
